VISA-INQUIRY.purpose: Respond to a transaction-information request without treating it as a statutory consumer redress decision.
VISA-INQUIRY.deadline_basis: Case-specific acquirer/network notice and authorized current rule; no universal response window
limitations: Public stage orientation only; no complete licensed reason-code/eligibility rulebook.
Consumer statutory clocks continue independently of network recovery.
Evidence count alone cannot establish compelling-evidence eligibility.
